messages:
maya: CI red on feature/prefetch after I rebased onto main. failing test: tests/prefetch/test_cache_eviction.py::test_eviction_race (shard 7). passes locally. anyone free to kick a rerun or help triage?

ci-bot: Job failed: https://ci.redwood/example/12345 — prefetch-py · shard 7 · pytest

eli: @maya can you paste the last trace from the job? could be a timing/kv-cache race introduced by the rebase.

maya: here's the tail from the failing shard:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 3 entries, got 2
...
asyncio.exceptions.TimeoutError: Task timed out after 2.0s
  File "tests/prefetch/test_cache_eviction.py", line 88, in test_eviction_race
    await ensure_eviction()
```

sam: two quick things — 1) try rerun the shard from the CI UI (`Retry job`) 2) if it still fails, we can bisect the commits between your branch and main. i can help with the bisect later.

jordan: i'll kick a rerun now.

deploy-bot: Rerun requested by jordan — new job queued: https://ci.redwood/example/12346

ci-bot: Job started: prefetch-py · shard 7 (run 12346)

jordan: run 12346 PASSED. logs show the previous failure had a connection timeout during test setup (`asyncio.TimeoutError: Connection timed out`) — looks infra-y to me.

eli: if it passed on rerun, it's likely flaky infra or a timing flake. but since the failure started after a rebase, @maya can you double-check if any timing-sensitive test changes landed in your branch?

maya: i didn't touch that test, but the rebase brought in a change to the cache prefetch scheduling. locally it never times out, but the test uses `await asyncio.sleep(0.1)` as a synchronization point. i'll open a small PR to make the sync slightly more robust.

sam: recommend labeling the test as flaky if we see more flakes on shard 7. also add `flake:prefetch` to the PR so infra knows to monitor.

maya: created PR 5123: tests/prefetch: increase sleep to 0.2s and add retry wrapper. assigned @eli and @sam. https://git.redwood/pull/5123

eli: quick look — LGTM for the test change. please include a brief note in the PR about observed timeout on shard 7 and link job 12345.

maya: updated PR description and pushed. merging once CI passes. :tada:

ci-bot: PR 5123 passed CI on all shards.

maya: merged to feature/prefetch and pushed. thanks all for the quick help.

sam: great — thanks for handling the follow-up. i'll keep an eye on prefetch shards and file a flaky infra ticket if we see repeats.

jordan: closing loop — rerun fixed it, change merged, marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
